messages:
raj: quick check — we have cross-repo deps that need a coordinated merge today: SDK PR #4827, API PR #4832, and console PR #210. SDK changes the client signature for streaming, API adds the compat shim, console updates the UI and helm chart.
linh: timeline? can we sequence them or do an atomic window?
sasha: atomic window preferred. if sdk lands first, console tests will fail until api shim is up.
raj: proposed sequence: 1) open a short freeze at 2pm PT, 2) merge API #4832 (compat shim), 3) merge SDK #4827, 4) merge console #210 + bump helm (chart v0.12.1 -> v0.12.2), 5) smoke and unfreeze.
alex: SGTM. who can approve API and console? I can approve SDK.
linh: I can approve API after a quick smoke. need @sasha to review console helm bump (values change for runtime image tag).
sasha: will review console in ~30m. FYI console PR also touches the deploy job so helm bump needs chart.lock update.
raj: note: CI showed a flaky e2e in console on last run. I've re-run once, passed. if it flakes again we should hold and fallback to staging merge only.
linh: can we add a pre-merge CI gate: helm lint + e2e-fast? quick snippet:
```bash
helm lint charts/redwood-console && ./scripts/e2e-fast.sh --smoke
```
alex: added that as a required check on the console PR.
deploy-bot: CI: console/pr-210 — helm lint: passed, e2e-fast: queued.
ci-bot: SDK/pr-4827 — unit tests: passed, integration: passed.
raj: timeline reminder: freeze opens 2pm PT, please be available for quick fixes. I'll coordinate merges and tagging.
linh: noted. will be online. can someone post the merge commands when we start?
sasha: will post helm bump command and chart version after review.
alex: once merged, I'll kick the canary rollout for dedicated infra and watch latencies.
raj: thanks — tagging the approvals: @linh (API), @alex (SDK already ok), @sasha (console/helm). see you at 2pm PT :thumbsup:
sasha: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: deploy window at 2026-03-17T14:00:00-07:00 (2pm PT).
raj: if any blocker arises, comment here and we'll pause and rollback as needed.
